subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) Democracy means (i) freedom of speech (b) Democracy (ii) is the precondition of encourages democracy (c) In democracy, people (iii) a democratic country have (d) Free and fair election (iv) right to elect their representatives (e) Bangladesh is (v) the rule of autocratic government (vi) the rule of general people (vii) a caretaker government
